domain_description: Comprehensive medical knowledge spanning pharmacology, toxicology, radiology, pathology, emergency medicine, surgery, internal medicine, pediatrics, psychiatry, oncology, cardiology, neurology, orthopedics, dermatology, and medical devices. Based on FDA regulations, USP standards, WHO guidelines, HIPAA compliance, AMA CPT coding, and ICD-10 classification systems.
authority_sources: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines
Goodman & Gilman's The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics

engines.name: Pharmacology Engine
engines.function: Analyze drug mechanisms of action, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, drug-drug interactions, dosing protocols, adverse effects, and therapeutic drug monitoring across all major drug classes per FDA labeling and USP standards.
doctrine_topics: drug-drug interaction analysis and CYP450 metabolism
adverse drug reaction classification and reporting

golden_queries.question: Analyze the drug interaction risk between warfarin, amiodarone, and fluconazole in a 72-year-old patient with atrial fibrillation and candidemia
Design a vancomycin dosing protocol for a 120kg patient with an estimated CrCl of 45 mL/min and suspected MRSA bacteremia

engines.name: Toxicology Engine
engines.function: Analyze poisoning syndromes, toxidromes, antidote protocols, decontamination strategies, occupational exposures, environmental toxicants, and forensic toxicology per AAPCC and ACMT guidelines.
doctrine_topics: heavy metal poisoning and chelation therapy

golden_queries.question: A 35-year-old farmer presents with miosis, bradycardia, excessive salivation, and fasciculations after spraying crops. Outline the complete management protocol.

engines.name: Radiology Engine
engines.function: Analyze medical imaging modalities, radiation physics, contrast protocols, imaging findings, differential diagnoses, and radiation safety per ACR Appropriateness Criteria and ICRP guidelines.
doctrine_topics: CT imaging protocols and contrast timing

golden_queries.question: Evaluate the appropriate imaging workup for a 55-year-old with new-onset seizure, including contrast considerations given eGFR of 35 mL/min

engines.name: Pathology Engine
engines.function: Analyze histopathological findings, cytology, molecular pathology markers, immunohistochemistry panels, staging systems, and laboratory diagnostics per CAP and ASCP guidelines.

golden_queries.question: A breast biopsy shows invasive ductal carcinoma. Outline the complete pathology workup including molecular profiling, staging, and prognostic markers.

engines.name: Emergency Medicine Engine
engines.function: Analyze emergency presentations, triage protocols, resuscitation algorithms, trauma management, and critical care pathways per ACLS, ATLS, and PALS guidelines.
doctrine_topics: stroke code activation and tPA criteria

golden_queries.question: A 60-year-old presents with sudden-onset worst headache of life, nuchal rigidity, and photophobia. CT head is negative. What is the next step and complete management pathway?

engines.name: Surgery Engine
engines.function: Analyze surgical procedures, operative planning, perioperative management, wound healing, surgical site infection prevention, and minimally invasive techniques per ACS and SAGES guidelines.
doctrine_topics: enhanced recovery after surgery ERAS protocols

golden_queries.question: A 68-year-old with BMI 35, diabetes, and COPD requires elective right hemicolectomy for colon cancer. Outline the complete perioperative optimization and ERAS protocol.

engines.name: Internal Medicine Engine
engines.function: Analyze complex medical diagnoses, multi-system disease management, evidence-based treatment protocols, and clinical decision-making across all internal medicine subspecialties per Harrison's and UpToDate evidence.
doctrine_topics: chronic kidney disease staging and treatment

golden_queries.question: A 58-year-old with type 2 diabetes, eGFR 38, HbA1c 9.2%, and NYHA Class II heart failure. Design a comprehensive medication regimen addressing all conditions.

engines.name: Pediatrics Engine
engines.function: Analyze pediatric growth and development, childhood diseases, vaccination schedules, neonatal care, and age-specific dosing per AAP guidelines and CDC immunization schedules.

golden_queries.question: A 3-year-old, 15kg child presents with moderate dehydration from gastroenteritis. Calculate the complete fluid resuscitation and maintenance plan including electrolyte composition.

engines.name: Psychiatry Engine
engines.function: Analyze psychiatric diagnoses, psychopharmacology, psychotherapy modalities, risk assessments, and involuntary commitment criteria per DSM-5-TR and APA practice guidelines.
doctrine_topics: suicide risk assessment and safety planning

golden_queries.question: A 28-year-old with treatment-resistant depression has failed two adequate SSRI trials and one SNRI trial. Outline the evidence-based next-step treatment algorithm.

engines.name: Oncology Engine
engines.function: Analyze cancer staging, chemotherapy regimens, immunotherapy protocols, radiation treatment planning, tumor board decision-making, and survivorship per NCCN guidelines and AJCC staging.

golden_queries.question: A 65-year-old is diagnosed with stage IIIA non-small cell lung cancer, adenocarcinoma, with EGFR exon 19 deletion and PD-L1 TPS 80%. Outline the treatment strategy.

engines.name: Cardiology Engine
engines.function: Analyze cardiovascular diseases, ECG interpretation, echocardiographic findings, catheterization data, heart failure management, and arrhythmia treatment per ACC/AHA guidelines.
doctrine_topics: valvular heart disease assessment and intervention

golden_queries.question: A patient presents with new-onset atrial fibrillation, CHA2DS2-VASc score of 4, HAS-BLED score of 3, eGFR 30 mL/min, and prior GI bleed 18 months ago. Recommend an anticoagulation strategy.
failure_signals: ignoring renal function for DOAC dosing

engines.name: Neurology Engine
engines.function: Analyze neurological conditions, stroke syndromes, seizure management, neurodegenerative diseases, neuromuscular disorders, and neurodiagnostic studies per AAN practice guidelines.
doctrine_topics: acute ischemic stroke tPA and thrombectomy criteria

golden_queries.question: A 45-year-old presents with acute-onset right-sided weakness and aphasia, last known well 2 hours ago. NIHSS score is 14. CT head shows no hemorrhage. Outline the complete acute management pathway.

engines.name: Orthopedics Engine
engines.function: Analyze musculoskeletal injuries, fracture classification, joint replacement planning, sports medicine conditions, and rehabilitation protocols per AAOS guidelines and AO/OTA classification.
doctrine_topics: joint replacement indications and prosthesis selection
sports medicine injury assessment and treatment

golden_queries.question: A 75-year-old osteoporotic female sustains a displaced femoral neck fracture (Garden IV). Outline the surgical decision-making including prosthesis selection and perioperative management.

engines.name: Dermatology Engine
engines.function: Analyze dermatological conditions, skin cancer screening, dermatopathology, biologic therapies for inflammatory skin disease, and procedural dermatology per AAD guidelines.
doctrine_topics: melanoma ABCDE criteria and Breslow staging
psoriasis severity assessment and biologic therapy

golden_queries.question: A patient presents with a pigmented lesion showing asymmetry, irregular borders, and color variation, measuring 8mm. Dermoscopy shows blue-white structures and atypical network. Outline the complete management.

engines.name: Medical Devices Engine
engines.function: Analyze medical device classification, FDA regulatory pathways, biocompatibility testing, quality management systems, and post-market surveillance per FDA 21 CFR and ISO 13485.
doctrine_topics: clinical trial design for medical devices IDE

golden_queries.question: A startup is developing an AI-powered cardiac monitoring wearable that detects arrhythmias and alerts physicians. Determine the FDA regulatory pathway and complete submission requirements.
required_elements: De Novo vs 510(k) vs PMA pathway
